body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> MSI unveiled its new 10-inch hybrid netbook 'U115 Hybrid' supporting up to 10.5 hours of battery life during CES 2009, which is equipped with both SSD and HDD drives. It primarily uses 16GB SSD and temporarily operates 160GB HDD with 'Eco Mode' to save power.

Powered by Intel Atom Z530(1.6GHz) processor, the U115 Hybrid adopts 2GB DDR2 RAM, a 10-inch LCD screen with 1024*600 resolution, a 2M webcam and 4-in-1 card reader. Running on Windows XP Home Edition OS, it supports WiFi b/g/n and Bluetooth connectivity.
